thread:
sara: deploy-bot just triggered an auto-revert suggestion for apac-dedicated during the midnight rollout. It wants to flip back to v4.0.2. Thoughts? :alarm_clock:
deploy-bot: AUTOREVERT_SUGGEST: apac-dedicated p95 degraded by +420ms (threshold +250ms). Autorevert window=enabled. Suggested action: revert to last-stable v4.0.2. event_id=evt_6654321.
matt.ops: Whoa. Autorevert would drop the new nodes; we have 2 paying dedicated customers pinned to the new instance type — sales needs a heads up before we revert.
sara: Right — we should avoid a hard autorevert that could impact reserved SLAs. Propose a manual partial rollback: 1) reduce rollout slice from 20% -> 5% 2) pin reserved pools for paying customers to keep them on v4.0.3 3) run targeted perf test 4) if regression persists, do full revert.
ani.product: Sounds reasonable. Can we do a quick gate: `deployctl check --pool apac-dedicated --metric p95 --window 5m --cmp v4.0.2,v4.0.3` and hold the autorevert?
sre-oncall: I can hold autorevert. Oncall override: `deployctl autorevert --disable --reason "manual triage; customer reserved pools"` — done.
matt.ops: Thanks. I'll pin the paying customers' pools: `deployctl pin --pool apac-reserved-1 --version v4.0.3` and same for apac-reserved-2.
deploy-bot: COMMAND: `deployctl pin --pool apac-reserved-1 --version v4.0.3` accepted. PinID=pin_665432A. COMMAND: `deployctl pin --pool apac-reserved-2 --version v4.0.3` accepted. PinID=pin_665432B.
sara: Reduced rollout slice now: `deployctl traffic --pool apac-dedicated --set 5%` (keeps canary live for diagnostics). JobID=job_665432C.
ani.product: Initiating perf job now: `perfcmp --pool apac-dedicated --from v4.0.2 --to v4.0.3 --samples 2000` ETA ~4m.
sre-oncall: Noticed increased KV-cache miss rate on v4.0.3 during warmup. Could explain latency. Leaving slice at 5% until heatmap cools.
matt.ops: Sales FYI: @sales_lead pinged — they're aware and want next steps if revert happens. Sales asks for a short customer-facing note draft.
sales_lead: Thx. Draft: "We're monitoring increased latency in APAC; we've paused the rollout for more testing and pinned reserved pools to ensure stability for customers on committed capacity. We'll follow up within 90 minutes"
sara: Good. If perfcmp shows that v4.0.3 is better except warmup, we can rerun rollout with longer warmup and cache priming. If it's worse vs v4.0.2 across steady-state, revert.
ani.product: perfcmp results: steady-state p95 v4.0.2=280ms, v4.0.3=710ms. Warmup diff bigger. Delta +430ms -> fail.
sre-oncall: Confirmed. Recommend full revert on apac-dedicated but keep reserved pins in place so paying customers aren't disrupted. I'll queue the revert: `deployctl revert --pool apac-dedicated --to v4.0.2 --graceful` and monitor.
deploy-bot: COMMAND: `deployctl revert --pool apac-dedicated --to v4.0.2 --graceful` accepted. RevertJob=rev_665432D.
matt.ops: Executing revert now. Scaling drain on nodes running v4.0.3.
sara: Posting release notes update: mark v4.0.3 rollout paused in APAC due to p95 regression; full revert executed on dedicated pool; reserved customer pools pinned to v4.0.3 to honor commitments.
sales_lead: Communicated to affected customers via direct outreach + ticket. Keeping them updated.
sre-oncall: Monitoring post-revert metrics: p95 dropped back to ~300ms after 6m. No 5xx spike. KV-cache stabilized.
sara: Closing decision: manual intervention (disabled autorevert), partial protections for reserved pools, then full revert for general dedicated pool. Follow-ups: runtime team to investigate cache warmup (TICKET: RUNTIME-512, assigned to @perf-team), product to evaluate longer warmup strategies for future rollouts.
ani.product: Adding rollout config item: warmup_seconds and cache-prime hook for future model releases.
matt.ops: Thanks all. I'll update the runbook to include reserved-pool pin step before any autorevert. :white_check_mark:
